description: This is a test source file for the AnySoftKeyboard project, specifically testing the behavior of setting and resetting the locale (language) configuration within the keyboard application across different Android API levels.

classes.name: AnySoftKeyboardForceLocaleTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing locale setting and resetting in the AnySoftKeyboard app.

methods.name: setUpLocale
methods.description: Sets the default locale to US before each test.

methods.name: tearDownLocale
methods.description: Resets the default locale to US after each test.

methods.name: testSetAndResetValueAPI21
methods.description: Tests setting and resetting locale on API level 21 (Lollipop).

methods.name: testSetAndResetValueAPI24
methods.description: Tests setting and resetting locale on API level 24 (Nougat).

methods.name: testSetEmptyValue
methods.description: Tests behavior when setting an empty locale value.
